title: SEO for per-request pages
why: Per-request pages got a WebPage at `*`, a missing title report and a site-name entry in llms.txt.
changelog: the not-found page carries only site nodes, per-request pages get the `WebSite` and `WebPage` graph with the request URL, `brain seo` no longer reports a per-request title or description as missing, and llms.txt names a per-request page by its route
